text: Annual UK consumer price inflation falls to 3% in January from 3.4% in December, with core inflation at 3.1%. Petrol, airfares, and food categories register declines. Sterling remains flat near $1.3562 as benchmark interest rate stands at 3.75% pending upcoming Bank of England review.

meta.note: Compression reflects narrowing inflation band; exposure limited to published statistical release.

text: FOMC minutes show disagreement on future rate direction while maintaining the federal funds range at 3.5%-3.75%. Some participants favor extended hold; others discuss possible cuts or potential hikes. Inflation remains near 3% on PCE measure as labor data presents mixed signals.

meta.note: Authority-split confined to deliberative layer; no policy action altered at meeting.
